question: In which of the following cities did Gautam Buddha get enlightenment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bodh Gaya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gautam Buddha,** also known as Siddhartha Gautama, was a **spiritual leader** and **founder of Buddhism**.
 
• He attained **enlightenment** under a **Bodhi tree** in Bodh Gaya, **Bihar, India.**
 
• Bodh Gaya is one of the most important** pilgrimage sites for Buddhists** around the world.
 
• The **Mahabodhi Temple**, located in Bodh Gaya, is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** and attracts millions of visitors every year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lumbini,** located in **Nepal, i**s the **birthplace** of Gautam Buddha.

 
 
• It is also a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** and a popular destination for Buddhist pilgrims.
 
 
 
• **Sanchi, **located in **Madhya Pradesh,** India, is famous for its **Buddhist stupas and monuments**.
 
 
• These were built by the **Mauryan emperor Ashoka** in the 3rd century BCE.
 
 
 
• **Kaushambi,** located in** Uttar Pradesh,** India, is an ancient city that was an important center for Buddhism in the** 6th century BCE. **
 
 
• **​**It is believed that Gautam Buddha **visited Kaushambi** several times during his lifetime.
